entities.name: Mazirek
entities.description: The immense death priest and leader of the kraul, who kills Sobeslav and his guards to open the mausoleum of Umerilek.

entities.name: Sobeslav
entities.description: A Golgari elf and assistant to Guildmaster Jarad who answers Mazirek's invitation and is killed by the kraul.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: The lich guildmaster of the Golgari who ignores the kraul and wanders the maze outside the Guildhall.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon, friend of Mazirek, who tells him how to bring about change without bloodshed and about the undead rising.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild of Ravnica that dwells in the Undercity and whose upper ranks treat the kraul as laborers.

entities.name: The Kraul
entities.description: An insectoid race that recently pledged allegiance to the Golgari after centuries unguilded and who serve as laborers.

entities.name: Ochran
entities.description: A group of assassins that Mazirek consulted when he first met Vraska.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: A being that can now walk, talk and leave, causing unfortunate happenings on Ravnica.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose communication with the Azorius has been shuttered.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose communication with the Orzhov has been shuttered.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose riots Sobeslav reads about.

entities.name: Korozda
entities.description: The immense circular maze of fungal hedgerows and ruins around the Golgari Guildhall.

entities.name: Svogthos
entities.description: The subterranean cathedral at the center of Korozda that serves as the Golgari Guildhall.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: The subterranean depths of Ravnica where the Golgari dwell.

entities.name: Kraul Cavern
entities.description: A large cavern deep below the Undercity where the kraul wait on the ceiling and a carved slab seals a mausoleum.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the Golgari and kraul live.

entities.name: Umerilek
entities.description: An ancient mausoleum with hundreds of stone coffins whose undead rise when Mazirek opens the slab; he calls it the salvation of the kraul.

entities.name: The Undead of Umerilek
entities.description: Undead in lace and rings who rise from their coffins in Umerilek.

events.summary: Sobeslav, Jarad's assistant, reads letters in the Guildhall and finds one from Mazirek of the kraul inviting Jarad.
Sobeslav laughs and tosses the invitation in the rot pit, then decides to investigate and orders fifteen guards assembled.
events.quote: Assemble fifteen members of the guard,

events.summary: Sobeslav uses a spell on the mushroom to find the meeting place and leads the guards on a three-day descent below the Undercity.
events.quote: On their third morning of journeying, Sobeslav called his guards to a halt.

events.summary: Sobeslav and his guards squeeze through a crevice into a cavern with a carved slab and discover hundreds of kraul clinging to the ceiling.
events.quote: There, clinging to the ceiling, waiting for their arrival, were the kraul.

events.summary: Mazirek drops from the ceiling and mocks Sobeslav as Jarad's lapdog; the kraul laugh and begin killing the Golgari by mind-attack.
events.quote: I invited Jarad vod Savo, and I received his lapdog instead.

events.summary: Mazirek asks what the Golgari think of the kraul, and Sobeslav answers that they are laborers who must pay their dues.
Guards collapse one by one as Mazirek kills them with the kraul's laughter, one piece of brain at a time, saving Sobeslav for last.
events.quote: I've been killing you and your guards for the last three minutes, one piece of your brain at a time.

events.summary: Mazirek says he needs a death to open the door.
events.quote: I need a death to open the door.

events.summary: In a memory, Mazirek and Vraska share tea and talk of leadership and pride.
events.quote: If I am to be met with disrespect, then I must first love myself with a fierceness no fool can take away.

events.summary: Mazirek recalls meeting Vraska while consulting the Ochran assassins, and their friendship since.
events.quote: Mazirek trusted Vraska with his life.

events.summary: The kraul chant as Mazirek harvests the souls of the dying guards and channels their power into his staff.
events.quote: Mazirek reached out and caught the power that resonated with each deceased soul

events.summary: In a memory, Mazirek rages that Jarad has cut the kraul's food and ignored them, and Vraska suggests change without bloodshed.
events.quote: There are plenty of ways to enact change without shedding blood.

events.summary: The dying Sobeslav says a kraul cannot lead the Golgari, and Mazirek replies that he will not, but knows who will.
Mazirek kills Sobeslav, drawing the elf's strength into his staff.
events.quote: Sobeslav's eyes went wide as his brain stem suddenly decomposed.

events.summary: With the power of sixteen souls, Mazirek shoves aside the stone slab and opens a mausoleum full of hundreds of stone coffins.
events.quote: He gripped either side of the stone slab and shoved it to the side.

events.summary: The coffins open and the undead rise of their own accord, as Vraska had told him they would.
events.quote: the undead began to rise of their own accord, just as Vraska had told him they would.

events.summary: Mazirek names the mausoleum Umerilek, the salvation of the kraul and key to a Golgari empire.
events.quote: Umerilek, Mausoleum of the Erstwhile, the salvation of the kraul and the key to the creation of the Golgari empire.

relations.note: death priest and leader of the kraul
relations.quote: I was born into my duty.

relations.note: close friends who meet to discuss theology and politics
relations.quote: their friendship had proven enriching through the years.
Mazirek felt pride as he killed Sobeslav cell by cell.
the great lich Jarad vod Savo.

relations.note: pledged allegiance recently and serve as laborers
relations.quote: only recently had declared allegiance to the Golgari Swarm.

relations.note: he resents Jarad's neglect and intends his downfall
relations.quote: But Jarad's time would come soon enough.
